name: Retirement Savings Are Fueling the AI Bubble
tagline: An article examining how retirement savings fund AI data center expansion
description: The article explains how public and private retirement accounts are being used to finance the rapid build‑out of AI data centers. It outlines the financial risks tied to massive AI spending, the role of private equity, and the potential impact on pension fund holders. The piece also discusses political reactions, regulatory concerns, and possible alternatives for directing retirement money toward more productive investments. It is aimed at policymakers, investors, pension trustees, and anyone interested in the intersection of finance and AI infrastructure.
